en-US: Replace the Xiaohongshu and X/Twitter factory AI prompts with Extract tasks and Continue writing. Opening the assistant on a whole note now starts on a custom instruction. After upgrade, those two factory presets—including edited copies—are removed; prompts you created yourself are kept.
Keep table layout stable when switching editor themes, give themes original four-character Chinese names, and balance desktop editor gutters so the reading column fills leftover width.
zh-CN: 内置 AI 提示改为笔记工作流：用「提取待办」和「继续写作」替换小红书、推特风格模板；对整篇笔记打开助手时默认进入自定义指令。升级后这两个出厂模板（含已编辑版本）会被移除，自建提示词不受影响。
切换编辑器主题时表格不再变形；主题使用独立四字中文名；桌面编辑区左右留白更均衡，阅读栏会填满中间剩余宽度。
